message.content:
[
  {
    "severity": "P0",
    "category": "injection",
    "location": "bono/mesh-wal-store.js:validateEntry",
    "issue": "JSONL injection via unescaped newlines in summary, question, answer, or context_refs",
    "rationale": "validateEntry checks length but allows \\n and control chars, allowing injection into JSONL format, corrupting the log or enabling data exfiltration",
    "fix": "Sanitize strings by replacing \\n with space in validateEntry"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P0",
    "category": "auth",
    "location": "bono/comms-server.js:PSK auth",
    "issue": "Agent field forgeable, allowing impersonation",
    "rationale": "Any PSK holder can set agent to 'james' or 'bono', no binding to token, enabling spoofing in WAL entries",
    "fix": "Derive agent from PSK or add cryptographic signature to agent field"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P1",
    "category": "dos",
    "location": "bono/comms-server.js:parseBody",
    "issue": "DoS via large body exceeding 64 KB cap",
    "rationale": "parseBody may not reject before JSON.parse, allowing memory exhaustion or parsing large payloads",
    "fix": "Ensure parseBody enforces MAX_BODY_BYTES before parsing"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P1",
    "category": "dos",
    "location": "bono/mesh-wal-store.js:_readAllAvailable",
    "issue": "Tail amplification DoS via 20 MB decompression per request",
    "rationale": "Decompresses up to 2 archives of 10 MB each, amplifying resource usage for tail calls",
    "fix": "Limit decompression size or cache decompressed archives"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P1",
    "category": "logic",
    "location": "bono/mesh-wal-store.js:ask",
    "issue": "Thread_id mutation after append leaves disk with null for root asks",
    "rationale": "thread_id set post-append, so persisted entry has null, inconsistent with returned object",
    "fix": "Set thread_id before append in ask()"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P1",
    "category": "race",
    "location": "bono/mesh-wal-store.js:_rotateNoLock",
    "issue": "Archive corruption risk if crash between writeFile and unlink",
    "rationale": "Both archive and original file exist, risking double-read or inconsistency",
    "fix": "Use atomic rename for rotation instead of writeFile + unlink"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P1",
    "category": "missing-feature",
    "location": "bono/comms-server.js:/mesh/wal/append",
    "issue": "No rate limiting on append, allowing flood attacks",
    "rationale": "Valid PSK holders can spam appends, exhausting storage or compute",
    "fix": "Implement per-IP or per-agent rate limiting"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P1",
    "category": "dos",
    "location": "scripts/mesh-wal-inject.js:Promise.all",
    "issue": "Hook blocking if one fetch hangs beyond timeout",
    "rationale": "Promise.all waits for all, and timeout may not abort hanging requests",
    "fix": "Use Promise.allSettled or individual timeouts with AbortController"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P2",
    "category": "logic",
    "location": "bono/mesh-wal-store.js:openDialogues",
    "issue": "O(N) iteration over all entries, bounded but inefficient",
    "rationale": "Iterates up to 500 entries per call, acceptable but could be optimized with indexing",
    "fix": "Add in-memory index for dialogue states"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P2",
    "category": "auth",
    "location": "bono/comms-server.js:timingSafeEqual",
    "issue": "Potential timing side-channel on PSK validation",
    "rationale": "If not using timingSafeEqual correctly, leaks PSK info via timing",
    "fix": "Confirm validatePsk uses timingSafeEqual on full hash comparison"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P2",
    "category": "logic",
    "location": "bono/mesh-wal-store.js:reply",
    "issue": "Forged correlation_id defense relies on _findById",
    "rationale": "Checks existence but doesn't verify ownership, though effective for preventing invalid replies",
    "fix": "Add check that reply agent matches ask.to or ask.from"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P2",
    "category": "race",
    "location": "bono/mesh-wal-store.js:append",
    "issue": "Rotation race mitigated by mutex",
    "rationale": "Mutex prevents append during rotation, but confirm no gaps",
    "fix": "No change needed, mutex sufficient"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P2",
    "category": "logic",
    "location": "bono/comms-server.js:error handling",
    "issue": "500 errors may leak internal paths",
    "rationale": "Exceptions could expose stack traces or file paths in responses",
    "fix": "Sanitize error messages in jsonResponse"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P3",
    "category": "missing-feature",
    "location": "scripts/mesh-wal-inject.js:TIMEOUT_MS",
    "issue": "Timeout enforcement on all fetches",
    "rationale": "Each request has timeout, but ensure no path bypasses it",
    "fix": "Verify all fetchJson calls respect TIMEOUT_MS"
  },
  {
    "severity": "P3",
    "category": "logic",
    "location": "bono/mesh-wal-store.js:validateEntry",
    "issue": "No newline stripping in context_refs",
    "rationale": "context_refs array elements may contain \\n, similar to summary",
    "fix": "Sanitize context_refs strings for newlines"
  }
]
